meta.name: clickhouse-js-node-coding
meta.description: Write idiomatic application code with the ClickHouse Node.js client (`@clickhouse/client`). Use this skill whenever a user is *building* against the Node.js client — configuring the client, pinging, inserting rows in JSON or raw formats, selecting and parsing results, binding query parameters, managing sessions and temporary tables, working with data types or customizing JSON parsing. Do NOT use for browser/Web client code.

copy.tagline: 编写 Node.js 代码操作 ClickHouse 数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用 Node.js 与 ClickHouse 交互写应用代码
copy.tagline_en: Write Node.js code to interact with ClickHouse
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write Node.js application code for ClickHouse

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你使用 Node.js 的 `@clickhouse/client` 库编写与 ClickHouse 交互的代码，包括配置客户端、插入数据、查询结果、参数绑定、管理会话和临时表等。
howto.when: 当你询问如何用 Node.js 客户端连接 ClickHouse，或涉及配置、插入、查询、参数绑定、会话等操作时触发。不适用于浏览器场景。

say.text: 帮我写一段用 @clickhouse/client 插入数据的代码。
如何用参数化查询绑定用户输入？
展示如何使用 session_id 和临时表。
say.note: Claude 会给出创建会话和临时表的代码。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude guides you to write idiomatic application code using the `@clickhouse/client` Node.js library: configuring the client, inserting rows, selecting and parsing results, binding query parameters, managing sessions and temporary tables, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about using the Node.js client to connect to ClickHouse, or when discussing configuration, inserts, queries, parameter binding, sessions, or temporary tables. Not for browser environments.

say_en.text: Write a code snippet that inserts data using @clickhouse/client.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an example using JSONEachRow format.

say_en.text: How do I bind user input with parameterized queries?
say_en.note: Claude will show the `{name: Type}` syntax and warn about SQL injection.

say_en.text: Show how to use session_id and temporary tables.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code for creating a session and a temp table.
